name: B10-0200/2026 (ECR) – Supporting democratic resilience in Armenia
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on supporting democratic resilience in Armenia
part_text:
The European Parliament calls for stronger EU support for Armenia's democracy and its move towards EU membership. It asks for help to protect Armenia's 2026 elections from foreign interference and disinformation, more money for reform and growth, and closer security cooperation. It also urges Armenia to reduce its dependence on Russia, and calls on Azerbaijan to release remaining Armenian prisoners and protect Armenian cultural sites. The text is a set of requests and opinions; it does not itself change any law.

- The EU is asked to fund election protection, reform and security aid for Armenia.
- Armenia, its voters and its government are the main ones affected.
- Next: EU and Armenian leaders meet at a summit in Yerevan in May 2026.
